card.name: The word metabolic before changes
card.fires_on: The word "metabolic" in antipsychotic warnings, right before "changes" and a list such as hyperglycemia, dyslipidemia and weight gain.

modes.label: Metabolic after verb
modes.description: "metabolic" follows "caused", "associated with" or "produce some" in the Metabolic Changes warning.
modes.example: Atypical antipsychotic drugs, including asenapine, have caused<< metabolic>> changes, including hyperglycemia,

modes.label: Metabolic repeated
modes.description: "metabolic" in a later sentence that refers back to the same changes.
modes.example: These<< metabolic>> changes include hyperglycemia, dys

card.writes: It pushes toward words about blood sugar, obesity, diabetes and diet, and away from unrelated words.
card.plain: It fires on the word "metabolic" when a label warns about metabolic changes from antipsychotics.
